definition.correction: correct(items) is compare-and-swap: each item is (text, expected_value, new_value); the expected value is the credential, the whole batch is validated before mutation, and every applied row is appended to an audit log
definition.plain_write: a plain write of a conflicting value is still rejected with the first writer kept; correction is a separate method, not a new conflict rule and not a parameter
definition.stale_credential: a correction whose expected value is not the currently bound value is rejected whole; nothing moves, the audit log does not grow
definition.unknown_address: a correction of a key that was never written is rejected whole
definition.batch_collision: one correction batch cannot bind the same key to two different new values; the batch is rejected before any row is applied
definition.chain: v1 -> v2 -> v3 must leave three audited steps in order and read v3
definition.round_trip: on the 18-key table, correct an alias to another value and back; content digest returns to the original, R15 stays 40/40, zeros stay 0/0, and the log has two entries
definition.rerun_anchors: R16 and R17 carry the commit at which their own runner bytes were last runnable, because R18 changes the bridge module their manifests pin
definition.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.plain_write: action rejected_batch_address_already_bound, content digest unchanged, read still the original value, corrections log empty
criteria.correction: action corrected, one row applied, read the new value, log length 1 with from=old and to=new, corrected count 1
criteria.stale_credential: action rejected_batch_correction_mismatch, content digest unchanged, read the corrected value, log length unchanged
criteria.unknown_address: action rejected_batch_unknown_address, content digest unchanged, log length unchanged
criteria.batch_collision: action rejected_batch_address_collision, content digest unchanged, read the original value, log empty
criteria.chain: two corrections applied, log from/to sequence is old -> middle -> final, read final
criteria.round_trip: content digest after the round trip equals the digest before it; alias reads the original value; regression 40/40 with wrong 0; zeros 0/0; log length 2
criteria.rerun: every row names a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and the bridge sha256 used by the report; a mismatch is declared in the row rather than hidden
criteria.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
criteria.reporting: segments are reported separately; a successful correction does not carry the rejection segments, and a rejected correction is evidence that the credential is checked
